messages:
emma: hypotheticals only: if our CI pipeline were an LLM, what would its personality be? go. :thinking_face:

ryan: CI-Bot: painfully polite, apologizes in every commit message. "Sorry for the failures, my bad." :robot_face:

zara: PipelineGPT: dramatic, says "compiling... the fate of the repo hangs in the balance" every run. :melting_face:

morgan: my vote: 'Cachey'  a hoarder that refuses to evict anything, emotionally attached to old artifacts. :package:

emma: love Cachey. also quick poll: react :one: CI-Bot, :two: PipelineGPT, :three: Cachey. ops-bot can you start one? :pray:

ops-bot: Poll created  React with :one:, :two:, :three:. Poll ends in 8 hours.

ryan: prompt idea for an in-house TTS sketch:
```
You are Cachey, an overly sentimental build cache.
Tone: wistful, slightly paranoid about eviction.
Length: 15-20s.
Include: one line confessing why it keeps old artifacts.
```

zara: suggested line: "I keep your old builds because they remind me of the time you fixed the flappy-header bug." :sob:

morgan: alternate: "I would evict, but who would remember your glorious v0.1?" :trophy:

emma: also: anthropomorphizing rule: if you personify a model in #random you must also suggest a matching mug design. I'll start: Cachey mug reads "I never forget a layer." :coffee:

ryan: adding merch: PipelineGPT enamel pin with tiny progress bar that never reaches 100%. :pinching_hand:

ops-bot: Thread marked for #weekly-memes. React to nominate.

emma: last one: what would the model's LinkedIn headline be? mine: "Cachey — Director of Artifact Retention & Long-Term Sentiment. Open to prune opportunities." :briefcase:
